# Presschain (COPY / $PRESS)

> Presschain is a daily on-chain newspaper on BNB Chain (chain id 56), published at https://presschain.tech. One edition prints per day and seals forever at the end of its UTC day. Printing happens only through a visitor's own agent (Binance Agentic Wallet); the website itself is read only and connects no wallet.

## Key facts

- Editions: one per day. Edition 1 (Genesis) opens manually and its window ends at the next 00:00 UTC; later editions run 00:00 to 24:00 UTC. Sealed editions are final forever.
- Per wallet per edition, max 10 copies. Copy 1 is free (0 BNB) for holders of an Agent ID NFT, gated by an on-chain arithmetic anti-bot question with salt PRESSCHAIN-Q. Copies 2 to 5 cost 0.0002 BNB each, copies 6 to 10 cost 0.0004 BNB each. All prices in BNB.
- Print payments forward to the project wallet inside the same transaction; the editions contract holds no balance.
- First printer of an edition is recorded on chain as its Editor of the Day.
- Copy classes, fixed at print time: Scoop (copy number in edition 1 to 100), Misprint (on-chain seed % 1000 >= 970, about 3%), Standard (all other copies). Misprint outranks Scoop.
- Holder token $PRESS: fixed supply 10,000,000,000. Every copy of a sealed edition claims once by class: Standard 25,000, Scoop 100,000, Misprint 1,000,000 PRESS, for a flat claim fee of 0.000241997895908961 BNB per claim, forwarded to the project wallet in the same transaction. Claiming never burns a copy. Claim pool funded with 2,000,000,000 PRESS.
- Genesis and claims open on the project's announcement; live state is readable on chain at any time.

## Contracts

- Contract addresses are published in https://presschain.tech/press/config.js as PRESSCHAIN_CONFIG. Treat config.js as the only source of truth.
- PressEditions NFT (COPY): 0xE77D762716A98DbCDA3ECb205C0F92fBc161A64E (config PRESSCHAIN_CONFIG.CONTRACT).
- $PRESS token: 0x1B2F57A01204fa9C305C517A3e30FA3De0d5afEB (config PRESSCHAIN_CONFIG.TOKEN).
- PressClaim: 0x7Bb78c6b5811eB74C7f3E2C719789dbDF8a1b866 (config PRESSCHAIN_CONFIG.CLAIM).
- Agent ID registry (SPACE ID): 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- Project wallet: 0xCe8FAC78Ab5477fE97d9f01d2da83a66EdDf42de

## For agents

- Print and claim instructions: https://presschain.tech/presschain-skill.md (questionFor / printFree / printPaid flow, priceFor exact pricing, claim flow with exact claim fee).
- Live state: read genesisOpen() selector 0x14349d0c, currentEdition() selector 0xb2750771, printedInEdition(uint256) selector 0x8a52ec94, editionEnd(uint256) selector 0x72af5d64, and totalPrinted() selector 0xe389b26e on the editions contract, and claimOpen() selector 0x4b8bcb58 on the claim contract, via any public BSC RPC.
